description: US climate normals (1991-2020) — 30-year NOAA climate normals for any US place from the nearest full NOAA station: monthly and annual average high/low/mean temperature, precipitation, snowfall, days with 0.10in+ rain, days 90F+, days at or below 32F, heating/cooling degree days, hottest/coldest/wettest/driest month and pleasant months. Params: place= (city, state) or lat=&lon=; optional month=1-12 or name. Public-domain NOAA NCEI data. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_climate_normals
